questions.question: What position did King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon give Gedaliah over the people left behind in Judah?
After Gedaliah was killed, why did the people and army commanders of Judah flee to Egypt?

answers.text: They were afraid of the Chaldeans
They were following the king of Egypt
They were running from a famine

questions.question: When Evil-merodach became king of Babylon, what did he do for King Jehoiachin of Judah?

answers.text: He sent him back to Judah
